knowledge.purpose: Image element with responsive sizing, alt text, and adapter-aware loading (Next.js / default)
useCases: Hero image on a marketing surface
Avatar replacement when the photo is large
Product image in a card or grid
antiPatterns: User profile photo at small sizes — use control.avatar
knowledge.implementation:
Empty or placeholder src keeps the layout: the slot renders a themeable box (card ground, dashed border) at the declared width/height/aspectRatio in the editor and in the live app; live it carries no label text. A platform placeholder src (data:image/svg+xml with pw-placeholder:<key>) is never drawn as the grey SVG: the block shows the themeable slot and sets data-pw-placeholder="<key>". hideWhenEmpty draws nothing for either.
Further use cases:
- Inline screenshot in documentation

props.name: src
props.description: Image URL, or the platform placeholder (a data:image/svg+xml value carrying pw-placeholder:<key>). An empty or placeholder src keeps the layout: the block draws a themeable slot of the same size, in the editor and in the live app (quiet there, no label), and a placeholder src exposes its key as data-pw-placeholder until the real picture replaces it.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: CSS aspect-ratio for the image slot, e.g. '16/9', '4/3', '1/1', '21/9', '3/2', or a number. Sets the slot ratio without forcing a fixed height; object-fit:cover keeps the photo filling it.

jsonSchema.description: Over-image heading on a dark bottom gradient (media-teaser pattern). Without it the block is a plain image.
Secondary line under the overlay heading.

An optional image (a logo beside a text brand): with no src, or only the platform placeholder, it draws nothing, in the editor too. Leave false for a content image: an empty or placeholder src then keeps the layout with a themeable slot.
